content: Country input strings and aggregate record counts only; no station coordinates, harmonic constituents, predictions or observations.
inputCorpusHashMethod: Sorted relative data JSON paths with country field: UTF-8 path, NUL, original bytes, NUL; SHA-256 of concatenation.
transformations: Extract country strings from raw data/**/*.json records and aggregate identical strings; country-code-lookup migration baselines are separate MIT-derived values.
termsPolicy: Preserve upstream terms and credits. The noncommercial TICON portion is identified separately; this inventory does not grant commercial-use permission or relicense upstream data.

license.notes: DMI API and bulk data terms: https://www.dmi.dk/friedata/dokumentation/terms-of-use. Harmonics fitted from predictions; centimetres converted to metres.

notes: Source credits are copied from pinned metadata.yaml. Per-record license fields are aggregated without alteration.
JMA records select the CC BY 4.0 option described by the pinned README under Public Data License 1.0; retain its JMA source/editing credit and TICON coordinate citation.
NOAA metadata requests no mandatory credit; its per-record public-domain declaration and disclaimer URL are retained.
TICON README general CC BY description does not override the 674 record-level CC BY-NC entries.
All upstream record transformations in credits describe Slackwater processing; this repository only extracts country strings and counts.
The runtime country registry derives from Wikidata CC0, independently of this consumer compatibility inventory.

additionalInventories.transformations: Distinct ISO alpha-2 country identifiers only; no coordinates, populations or place names.
